## How to get the most out of this course

1. **Before the lecture**, skim the notes section for that week.
2. **In the lecture**, follow the slides and join in with the quick questions.
3. **After the lecture**, work through the linked problems: try first, use the hint, then check the answer.
4. Use the [exam formula sheet](resources/formula-sheet.qmd) (the equations you are given in the exam) and the [problem-solving strategy](resources/solving-strategy.qmd) while solving problems, and come to the workshops with questions.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Found a mistake or something unclear? Highlight the text on any page and click the **⚑ Report a mistake** button that appears. It opens a short form with the location already filled in; just say what is wrong.
:::
